column1: # allowed_lumeninfo.tsv: the gmpf getters LumenInfo (apps/LumenInfo, org.lumen.info) may send on the Z9X HB
# (goat_elegant) in addition to its rows of allowed.tsv. Design decision 2026-11-01 ("Lumen Info - разрешаю", the
# list of the design notes "Чего нет"). A separate file because allowed.tsv is HbProjector's exact list (rule 6 of
# tools/devices/check_aidl_hal.py: every row there must be a Call of HbProjector). Read only by the LumenInfo host
# test (apps/LumenInfo/test): every row must be a row of core.Hb.PLAN and of aidl_codes.tsv with the same method
# and signature, none a BANNED / REVIEW row of banned.tsv, none in allowed.tsv, and every PLAN row must be in
# allowed.tsv or here. DISPLAY 26 isPlayingHDRVideo of the maintainer's list is NOT here: banned.tsv has it BANNED
# (P6-NoteA, Z9X IGmpf 194 forbidden); it stays out until its own decision.
# Read-only proof per row: the signature (aidl_codes.tsv) has no setter shape (only a port / device selector or the
# DISPLAY 103 source + picture mode as arguments, a value or an out-struct back); the stock callers only read the
# value; the stock wire is the Java proxy xgimi/hardware/gmpf/I<Name>$Stub$Proxy of SystemUI release 838
# Arguments LumenInfo sends: HDMI port 1 / 2 (TV 70, TV 153), device 2 = HDMI ARC (GmAudio 33 / 34; stock
